query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS instructor_course_permissions (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  instructor_id INT NOT NULL,
  course_id INT NOT NULL,
  can_self_publish BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  requires_lesson_approval BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  granted_by_admin_id INT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY uq_instr_course (instructor_id, course_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS instructor_publish_requests (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  course_id INT NOT NULL,
  instructor_id INT NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('pending','approved','rejected') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  note TEXT,
  review_note TEXT,
  reviewed_by_admin_id INT,
  requested_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  reviewed_at TIMESTAMP NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS instructor_lesson_submissions (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  lesson_id INT NOT NULL,
  course_id INT NOT NULL,
  instructor_id INT NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('pending_review','approved','rejected') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_review',
  note TEXT,
  review_note TEXT,
  reviewed_by_admin_id INT,
  submitted_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  reviewed_at TIMESTAMP NULL,
  INDEX idx_lesson (lesson_id),
  INDEX idx_instructor (instructor_id),
  INDEX idx_status (status)
);

ALTER TABLE lms_instructors 
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS display_name VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS title VARCHAR(255) NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS social_links TEXT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS requires_lesson_approval BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS linked_user_id INT NULL;
